parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent query exists.
- If a subsequent query exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the route association. Valid values:
- **Active**: active.
- **Associating**: being associated.
- **Dissociating**: being dissociated.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the next hop resource.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the next hop resource. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.
- **VBR**: virtual border router (VBR) instance.
- **TR**: transit router instance.
- **VPN**: VPN connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterRouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router route table.
